options.description: Verdicts stay on this machine and in the archive. Git keeps the records and your decisions only.
options.label: Out of git (Recommended)

options.description: Every verdict stays committed, as on main today. The repository keeps growing with each judge run.
options.label: Keep them in git

payload.question: Old judge verdicts. The design-review branch started on 26 Oct, from the review that found about 44,000 plumb log files in git, mostly judge verdicts (19,770 of them). The rule keeps each verdict on disk and in the archive, just not tracked by git. Anything that records your decisions (approvals, your choices) stays in git, holding the outcome but not your words. I'd drop the verdicts from git: they're the judge's working notes, the outcome already sits on each record, and the volume slows every git and plumb command. Keep them out of git?
